decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates (ACT) sit close to the firm's core glass processing competence and serve growing glass packaging demand, so with the firm growing and having slack there is no performance shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of these resources.

VLIS was launched in 2024 as a flagship through-glass-via technology, its results are still uncertain, and the firm's growth and investment slack let it carry the product while it builds toward its strategy of higher-value proprietary products.
